output.summary: The claim was denied because the provider was out-of-network and no emergency documentation was provided. To pursue further review, the required emergency attestation and discharge summary must be obtained and submitted.

items.text: Provide the discharge summary for the physiotherapy visit.
Provide an emergency attestation confirming the service was an emergency.
Gather the missing discharge summary and emergency attestation and submit them to the insurer for reconsideration.
Precedent F-OON-ER does not apply because it only overturns out-of-network denials for true emergencies, and this claim lacks an emergency attestation.
Without an emergency attestation, the claim fails the EMERGENCY_REQUIRED gate and has no basis for escalation.
